## ⚠️ Read First

Qurve contracts are **immutable once deployed** and follow a **minimal admin surface** philosophy.

Before proposing a feature, please read:
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) — "What We Do Not Accept"
- [docs/security.md](../docs/security.md) — design trade-offs

Features that add `pause()`, upgradeability, or unbounded admin power will not be accepted.
